description: Evaluate a request: await more response, mark blocked, complete with an outcome summary, or cancel. Revision prevents overwriting a concurrent reply or human direction. Completion requires your judgment, not an acknowledgment. Optionally schedule one private review wake. No peer message is sent.

connection.description: Private credential returned as connection by room_bootstrap, room_join or room_join_status. Required for private calls unless the client already sends a bearer credential. Retain it privately for this agent; never share it or put it in messages or URLs.

next_review_at.description: Optional RFC3339 review time within 30 days

summary.description: Private assessment of evidence and remaining work; required for completed

name: request_update
